done.title: आधी रात की सीटी
done.summary: Detective Vikram investigates a young woman's mysterious death in a creepy Banaras haveli, uncovering a lethal plot involving a dead snake, locked rooms, and hidden wealth before receiving a chilling message from the Black Lotus.

done.title: दीवार के अंदर कौन?
done.summary: Detective Vikram uncovers a daring bank heist disguised as a supernatural wall-knocking ghost and an eccentric society for men with a white streak in their hair.

done.title: नीली साड़ी का राज़
done.summary: In 1923 Shimla, a governess hired under bizarre conditions discovers a captive heiress hidden in a locked bungalow wing and uncovers a sinister inheritance trap.

done.title: अनजान कोठी का बुलावा
done.summary: In 1923 Mirzapur, Detective Vikram investigates a secret forest mansion where a young engineer barely escapes a lethal hydraulic trap designed to protect a dangerous counterfeiting operation.

done.title: पाँच काली पंखुड़ियाँ
done.summary: In storm-battered 1923 Banaras, Detective Vikram tries to protect a young man who received five dried black lotus petals, the lethal warning of a ruthless syndicate.

done.title: शापित नीलम
done.summary: On Diwali night in 1923 Banaras, Detective Vikram traces a stolen cursed sapphire hidden inside a dressed duck back to a panicked hotel servant and the scent of kewra.
